**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI Laws | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and highway exits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | TxDOT – Headlight Regulations | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must be registered and display valid license plates.
• Towing regulations for trailers and vehicles. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) – Registration | | **Parking Rules** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or on sidewalks.
• Parking restrictions vary by city ordinances. | Local City Ordinances | | **School Bus Laws** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing Guidelines | | **Traffic Cameras & Enforcement** | • Cameras are used for red‑light, speed, and school‑zone enforcement. | TxDOT – Traffic Camera Program | | **Electronic Toll Collection** | • E‑Tag (TxTag) required for toll roads. | TxDOT – Toll Roads | ### How to Get the Full Text of the Law 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website. 2. **TxDOT** – Provides fact sheets, brochures, and interactive maps. 3. **TxDMV** – Offers downloadable driver handbooks and registration guides. 4. **Local County Websites** – For city‑specific ordinances (e.g., Dallas, Houston, Austin). ### Quick Tips for Drivers in Texas - **Always check for posted speed limit changes**—they can differ on rural vs. urban roads. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on your phone. - **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance up to date** to avoid fines. - **Be extra cautious in school zones**—speed limits drop significantly. - **Know your city’s parking rules**—they can be stricter than state law. If you need detailed statutes or want to verify a specific regulation, let me know the exact topic, and I can pull up the relevant code section or TxDOT guidance!
